title: RS3 Equilibrium residual combat gaps after Wave F
testsNote: 310 combat + component tests as of Wave F integrate (2026-07-26)
scope: Honest residual gaps after Wave F combat work. Closed items are summary-only; open items are actionable gaps with severity.

closedRecently.detail: Simulation applies major style buffs on cast: Berserk, Death's Swiftness / Greater, Sunshine / Greater Sunshine (inside-zone assumption), Instability + Lightning Surge, Chaos Roar empower window, Fury / Greater Fury crit grants, Meteor Strike passive adren, Greater Flurry Berserk extend, Searing Winds bonus hits. Remaining buff holes are called out under open gaps (Greater Barge idle, Pulverise defensive, Planted Feet).

Product decision: PvME ST is primary; multi-target bars intentionally omitted. Provenance docs: scraped-data/combat-revo-bars-pvme-st-2026-07-26.md and combat-revo-bars-wiki-pvme-2026-07-26.md.

resolveBar + revoManagedSlots + revolution sim path exist; hybrid bars only auto-fire the revolutionSize prefix. ST coverage matrix tested (melee/ranged/magic full engine; necro 7 engine + Sacrifice record + 3 conjure nulls).

shared:sacrifice resolves via record adapter (modelledBy: "record"), style overridden to the bar style. No engine AbilitySpec yet; enough for Revo sim. Documented in combat-revo-ability-coverage-2026-07-26.md.

Necro ST bar slots for Conjure Undead Army / Vengeful Ghost / Skeleton Warrior ship with abilityId: null (modelledBy: "unmodelled"). Product choice: summon setup not modelled as damage casts; not an accidental mapping miss. Auto ticks remain state-side notes only.

gaps.description: All 56/56 equipment records in data/combat/equipment.json have empty bonuses: {}. Post-9 Mar 2026 per-item combat stats remain unsourced; src/combat/shared/equipment.ts only models set crit-chance helpers (Tectonic, Tumeken's Resplendence in Sunshine). Loadout weapon tier can fall back to manual loadout.weaponTier, but there is nothing to aggregate from item records for accuracy, armour, prayer, or AD-affecting stats. Gear UI now admits this honestly.
gaps.recommendation: Source per-item bonuses (wiki equipment pages or a verified bulk dump with verifiedAt), populate bonuses fields, and add an aggregator used by loadoutStats. Until then keep empty objects — do not invent numbers. Prioritise weapons/armour that drive AD and accuracy for ST BiS setups.

gaps.description: Crackling, Planted Feet, Aftershock, Relentless, Caroming remain formula-only. Invigorating + Impatient are now sim-wired. Planted Feet: PLANTED_FEET_DURATION_MULT = 1.25 not applied to Sunshine/DS durations.
gaps.recommendation: Optional EV for Crackling/Aftershock over horizon. Planted Feet duration mult on base Sunshine/DS only when greater variants off.

gaps.description: Partial closure only. Many engine channels/DoTs now carry wiki tickOffset schedules (Assault, Flurry, Asphyxiate, Rapid Fire, bleeds, etc.) and simulate.ts lands expected damage on readyTick + tickOffset. Residual issues: (1) module comment on simulate() still documents ponytail 'channelled hits still land on the cast tick'; (2) multi-hits without a wiki inter-hit schedule intentionally have no offsets (Wild Magic, Hurricane, several twin hits) so all damage stacks on cast tick; (3) record-adapter specs (specFromRecord) never emit tickOffset — flat simultaneous hits; (4) style buff multipliers for a cast are still evaluated at readyTick (cast tick), not per landTick, so multi-hit channels under a buff window that expires mid-channel are not time-sliced.
gaps.recommendation: Refresh the stale simulate() ponytail comment to match current tickOffset behaviour. Audit any remaining channelled AbilitySpecs that still omit offsets where the wiki states an interval. For buff windows, evaluate damage mult per landTick when tickOffset is present. Do not invent offsets where wiki is silent.

gaps.description: Greater Barge base hit (75–95%) is modelled; appliesBuff marker exists. Idle damage scale (+5 min / +7 max AD% per idle tick, cap 10 ticks / 6s) and Endless Assault (after 4.8s idle, next channelled melee within 6s treated as DoT) are UNVERIFIED in sim. Helpers exist in styles/melee/effects.ts (greaterBargeIdleBand) but are not auto-wired. Wiki tooltip vs analysis conflict on whether idle is pure last-attack time or off-target movement (Surge/Escape/Bladed Dive) — sim correctly refuses to invent an idle clock. Comment in simulate.ts: 'greater_barge: idle scale + Endless Assault need off-target idle (UNVERIFIED in sim).'
gaps.recommendation: Resolve idle definition from a single authoritative source (live test or unambiguous wiki analysis). Only then wire an off-target idle clock into the sim and apply greaterBargeIdleBand + Endless Assault channel transform. Until verified, leave base hit only.

gaps.description: Pulverise hit band (300–340%), 60% adren cost, 60s CD, ultimate category are engine-modelled and on the 2H ST bar. Outgoing DPS sim does not model Pulverised (−25% damage dealt by target for 30s) or on-kill +50% adren — defensive / kill-gated effects against a generic immortal target. Documented in MELEE_EFFECTS notes and simulate.ts skip comment.
gaps.recommendation: Optional: when target model gains kill/HP or defensive DPS, apply PULVERISE_DEBUFF_DAMAGE_REDUCTION to target outgoing and grant kill adren. Not required for pure player-DPS ST ranking.

gaps.description: Style/bar mismatch risk for shared-style and multi-style slots. Current code: resolveBarSlot passes bar.style into specFromRecord for shared records (Sacrifice → necro/ranged/etc.). Tests assert necro Sacrifice gets style necromancy and modelledBy record. Concurrent agent work may still be fixing remaining mismatches (wrong engine map, setup-dependent Adaptive Strike, bar style vs ability style). Flag as residual until a full ST bar resolve matrix is re-run after concurrent edits.
gaps.recommendation: After concurrent agents land, re-run resolveBar matrix for all PvME ST bars and assert every non-null abilityId resolves engine|record with style matching bar (or documented shared override). Fix any remaining Adaptive Strike setup / map drift.

gaps.description: Multi-target PvME and wiki Revolution bars are intentionally omitted from data/combat/revolution-bars.json. App scope is single-target only (product decision 2026-07-26). Multi-target ability mechanics (Soul Strike splash, Blood Siphon channel to non-primaries, Death Skulls bounce, etc.) are also thin or solo-only in engine.
gaps.recommendation: Keep omitted until ST path is solid. If product expands, import multi bars only after conjure policy and multi-hit primary/splash models exist; do not half-ship multi bars with silent zero damage.

gaps.description: Uncommitted mixed git tree risk: multiple agents and data/engine waves on the same day leave combat, scraped-data, and possibly unrelated files dirty together. Prior combat-sync validation already saw local/remote divergence and concurrent uncommitted data work. Clash-rename / partial commits can silently drop or mix Wave F combat fixes with unrelated progression scrapes.
gaps.recommendation: Before any combat commit: git status scoped to src/combat, data/combat, scraped-data/combat-*, docs/combat-*; stage only combat-owned paths; run vitest combat suite. Do not bundle regional-skilling or asset dumps with combat. Reconcile with origin/main before push. This report file is documentation only — do not commit it as a stand-in for code freezes.
